Dec 19, 2024

## [Terrible customer service, avoid Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/67645d786237157d96f89fbf)
I'm very disappointed with Lulu and Georgia. I ordered a mirror and a rug. When my mirror broke in transit, the customer service was terrible and I sent numerous messages to ask for the replacement mirror to be shipped white glove but they sent it via drop ship anyway.In addition, the rug I ordered with white glove is showing up as curb delivery in their delivery company's system. I reported this issue also and no response.

December 19, 2024

Unprompted review

* * *

1

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Dec 26, 2024

Hello Yasemin, we are so incredibly sorry to hear about the condition of the mirror. We can see you’ve been corresponding with our Customer Experience team, and they are sending a replacement order. Our team has also been in touch with our freight carrier to ensure that the rug that you ordered is delivered with the White Glove service. Please let us know if we maybe of further assistance in the meantime.
